prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: replacement decorative backdrop for a "Coaching as comrades" webpage in an established dark pixel-art personal website.
Create one complete image, very tall 3:8 portrait composition, ideally 768 by 2048 pixels. No collage or comparison sheet.
Style: carefully drawn 16-bit adventure-game pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, blocky contours, subtle restrained dithering, detailed but quiet natural scenery. Midnight navy and dark blue-green, subdued cream highlights, one small warm amber accent. Low overall brightness so it belongs beside an almost-black reading panel. No blurry painting, photorealism, 3D rendering or vector art.
Composition: upper 45 percent is quiet dark sky and distant scenery, because a navigation panel covers this area. The two adults are small, equally prominent, and centered horizontally in the central 65 percent of the width. Their heads start around 54 percent down the full canvas; keep the complete group compact around 54–70 percent. A natural foreground fills the lower portion and fades into deep ink at the bottom. Both people need readable, natural silhouettes in a narrow crop.
Human direction: two peers comfortable thinking aloud together. Same scale and eye level, relaxed shoulders and natural hands. Neither acts as a leader, instructor, audience member or note-taking assistant. Viewed from behind or a rear three-quarter angle, faces not identifiable. Casual dark outdoor clothes.
Avoid: pointing fingers, raised or extended arms, grand gestures, heroic summit poses, handshakes, hands on shoulders, romantic posing, exaggerated smiles, business suits, podiums, arrows, symbols of hierarchy, extra people, text, lettering, logos, watermarks, UI, frames, neon, bright dramatic sunsets, oversized moon.
Scene: a sheltered rest stop beneath a broad coastal tree at dusk, with dark water and distant hills beyond. Two adult companions sit at the same height on a simple low wooden bench, seen from a rear three-quarter angle. An open notebook rests on the bench in the space between them. Both lean toward it just a little, with equal curiosity. One person's hands rest loosely together on their knees; the other's hands rest on the bench beside their own legs. Neither points, writes while being instructed, or gives a presentation. The notebook pages have only tiny indistinct marks, no readable writing. One small lantern on the ground softly illuminates the shared notebook and both people equally. The tree canopy and dark open sky occupy the quiet upper half; a rough path and muted grasses lead toward the bench from the foreground. Show an informal shared pause to work something out, not a formal coaching session.
